facts.text: I am looking for inspiration for my next art project.
I have been really into abstract landscapes lately.
I love how some artists evoke a sense of atmosphere and mood through their use of colors and textures.
I want tips on how to get started creating non-representational abstract art that emphasizes colors and textures to evoke atmosphere and mood.
I think I will start by experimenting with different color palettes.
I want recommendations for specific color combinations that would evoke a sense of atmosphere and mood.
I am thinking of creating an abstract piece inspired by a sunset.
I want tips on how to capture the warm, vibrant colors of a sunset in an abstract piece.
I am thinking of creating a piece that captures the feeling of a sunset over a mountain range.
I want tips on how to suggest a sense of depth and distance in an abstract piece like that.
I think I will try layering and glazing to create a sense of depth and atmosphere.
I have been experimenting with different brushstrokes and textures.
I want tips on how to choose the right brushes and materials for an abstract piece like this.
I think I will try using a mix of natural hair and synthetic brushes to achieve a range of effects.
I have been experimenting with different surfaces, like canvas and paper, to see what textures and effects I can get.
I want tips on how to create a sense of movement and energy in an abstract piece.

keyphrases: depth and distance in abstract art
